title: The King Who Kept the Wrong Promise

pages.caption: Cover: King Herod makes a promise at his birthday meal.
Herod hears about Jesus and thinks he is John the Baptist, back from the dead. The story turns to what had happened to John.
John tells Herod that marrying his brother's wife is wrong. Herod has John put in prison.
Herodias wants John killed, but Herod keeps him safe and likes listening to him.
Herod gives a birthday meal. After Herodias' daughter dances, he offers to give her what she asks for.
Herod makes a strong promise, offering up to half his kingdom.
The girl asks her mother what to request, then asks Herod to have John killed.
Herod is very sad but will not refuse because of his promise and the guests.
Herod sends a man to the prison with the order. John's death is stated over a closed door without showing violence.
John's followers hear what happened and lay his body in a tomb. No body is pictured.
